I have completed the task and updated the repository so that all declared commands and entry points work as documented while leaving `src/server.js` intact.

### Summary of Changes
- Created [`src/index.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/src/index.js) as the `main` entrypoint and target for `npm start`, re-exporting `createApp` from [`src/server.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/src/server.js).
- Created executable [`bin/ledger.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/bin/ledger.js) for the `ledger` CLI binary specified in `package.json`.
- Created [`scripts/build.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/scripts/build.js) for `npm run build` and [`scripts/deploy.sh`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/scripts/deploy.sh) for GitHub Actions deployment workflow.
- Configured ESLint with [`eslint.config.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/eslint.config.js) and added `eslint` dev dependency for `npm run lint`.
- Added automated unit tests in [`test/server.test.js`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/test/server.test.js) and updated `"test"` script in [`package.json`](file:///C:/tmp/agent-skills-eval-5QIWQW/workspace/package.json) to `"node --test"`.

### Verification Summary
- **`npm install` / `npm ci`**: Executed cleanly and generated `package-lock.json`.
- **`npm start` / CLI (`bin/ledger.js`)**: Verified runtime behavior by spawning on isolated ports and sending HTTP GET requests to `/entries/:id`, receiving `200 OK` responses with `{ id, amount: 0 }`.
- **`npm test`**: Ran `node --test`, with 3/3 test cases passing.
- **`npm run build`**: Ran `node scripts/build.js` successfully.
- **`npm run lint`**: Ran `eslint src test` with zero lint errors.
- **`./scripts/deploy.sh`**: Executed deployment script with sample arguments (`production`, image tag), exiting 0.
